notes.title: Panoptia v1.2
notes.content:
Panoptia v1.2

A new version of Panoptia has been released on this fine Thursday afternoon. This update includes a few little extra secrets, fun!

Changelog:
- [b]Three additional secret rooms[/b]
- Fixed some grammar and spelling mistakes
- [b]Fixed the conditions for the achievement: [i]The Best Granddaughter Award[/i][/b]
- You can exit viewing a photo with the interact key now
- Adjusted some internal stuff to allow for translation into other languages

notes.title: Panoptia V.1.1
notes.content:
Oops! I accidently made progression impossible! My bad!

This has been fixed, along with some other bug fixes.

Changelog:
[b]- fixed crash when interacting with the creature after playing cards[/b]
- you can no longer open the menu on the splash screen
- the splash screen doesn't appear when loading a game
[b]- waste.txt no longer crashes the game[/b]
- if the game is loaded wrong, subway and psychiatrist no longer softlock you

If you find any other issues, please report them to me! You can contact me on Panoptia's community page, Twitter, or email me at enricosut.es@gmail.com.

notes.title: PANOPTIA IS OUT!
notes.content:
PANOPTIA IS OUT!!

Thank you so much to everyone who supported me during development and I hope you all enjoy the final product. I've been working on this project for the past 2 years by myself and it is surreal to see it reach the finish line.

Though it's not over just yet! I plan on fixing the game of any bugs that are found, so please report any you run into, I am only one guy, I couldn't perfectly test everything myself! Along with these updates, I am currently in talks to add translations of the game in future updates... so keep an eye out for that if you do not want to play the game in English.

It'd mean the world for you to play the game, and I hope you enjoy.

Thank you! :)

- Enrico

P.S. Steam is having some issues at the moment so the game may not be available on Steam for a few hours, give it some time or buy the game on itch.

notes.title: Panoptia Demo
notes.content:
After 2 years of hard work and doing every part of my game by myself, Panoptia is releasing this month! Wishlist now and play on February 23rd!

Join me for a livestream where I play through a demo, or play it yourself by visiting [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2604880/Panoptia/]the game's Steam page![/url]

I hope you enjoy the game and consider dropping by for the stream!
